{
  "contract": "AmenoToken",
  "closure": {
    "site_function": "swapAndSendMarketingFee",
    "site_call": ".call",
    "functions": [
      "transfer",
      "transferFrom",
      "claimMarketingFees",
      "excludeFromFees",
      "excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees",
      "setSwapTokensAtAmount",
      "setLiquiditFee",
      "setmarketingFee",
      "setBurnFee",
      "setMaxTxAmount",
      "blacklistAddress",
      "swapOnDemand",
      "deflationaryBurn",
      "setmarketingWallet"
    ],
    "justification": "Includes all public/external functions that can affect pendingMarketingFee, pendingBurnFee, or _balances."
  },
  "protocol": {
    "during_phase": "exposed",
    "allowed_callbacks": [
      "transfer",
      "transferFrom",
      "claimMarketingFees",
      "excludeFromFees",
      "excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees",
      "setSwapTokensAtAmount",
      "setLiquiditFee",
      "setmarketingFee",
      "setBurnFee",
      "setMaxTxAmount",
      "blacklistAddress",
      "swapOnDemand",
      "deflationaryBurn",
      "setmarketingWallet"
    ],
    "nesting_bound": {
      "transfer": 1,
      "transferFrom": 1,
      "claimMarketingFees": 1,
      "excludeFromFees": 1,
      "excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees": 1,
      "setSwapTokensAtAmount": 1,
      "setLiquiditFee": 1,
      "setmarketingFee": 1,
      "setBurnFee": 1,
      "setMaxTxAmount": 1,
      "blacklistAddress": 1,
      "swapOnDemand": 1,
      "deflationaryBurn": 1,
      "setmarketingWallet": 1
    }
  },
  "phases": {
    "function": "swapAndSendMarketingFee",
    "pre": {
      "name": "pre",
      "from_marker": "entry",
      "to_marker": "before_call"
    },
    "exposed": {
      "name": "exposed",
      "from_marker": "before_call",
      "to_marker": "after_call"
    },
    "post": {
      "name": "post",
      "from_marker": "after_call",
      "to_marker": "exit"
    },
    "linearization_point": "after_call"
  },
  "ghost_state": [
    {
      "name": "inFlight",
      "sol_type": "uint256",
      "meaning": "Amount of marketing fees in flight during the callback window",
      "backed_by_storage": false
    }
  ],
  "exposure_invariant": {
    "formula": "pendingMarketingFee + pendingBurnFee <= _balances[address(this)] + inFlight",
    "stable_formula": "pendingMarketingFee + pendingBurnFee <= _balances[address(this)]",
    "kind": "bounded"
  },
  "composition": {
    "target_property": "pendingMarketingFee + pendingBurnFee <= _balances[address(this)]",
    "rule": "The exposure invariant ensures that the sum of pending fees does not exceed the contract's balance, accounting for in-flight changes during callbacks."
  }
}
